integrity.proof_basis: exact integer finite certificate for \(2\le n\le7\); symbolic eight-vertex polynomial comparison and symbolic all-\(n\ge8\) spider argument
integrity.reproducibility: python3 verify_vaccination.py, Python standard library only, exact integer and Fraction computations
integrity.scientific_risk: External independent review and exhaustive literature coverage have not been performed; model assumptions are essential.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns independent and identically distributed edge transmission on finite contact trees, one fixed vaccinated vertex, and one uniformly selected seed after deletion.
It does not establish general conclusions for cyclic or weighted networks, nonindependent transmission, multiple initial cases, dynamic recovery/infection-time distributions, or multiple vaccinees.
The complete low-order cutoff is proved by exhaustive exact Prüfer-tree enumeration and Bernstein certificates; the all-larger-orders construction is proved symbolically.

Literature priority is checked against material accessible to the scientific analysis, including a full 2017 comparison; a possibly relevant 2004 paper was accessible only by abstract and remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp eight-vertex onset of transmissibility-dependent optimal vaccination on contact trees
